partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Interacting co-enabler LOF compensation
results.hypothesis: Increasing an interacting co-enabler of the same compact molecular activity as a LOF disease driver can provide functional compensation.
results.body: drug increases directly bound target; target physically interacts with LOF driver; both enable one compact molecular activity
results.mechanism_rationale: Drug direction, target-driver interaction, shared molecular function, top-ranked causal genetics, and explicit LOF direction jointly define a complex-level compensation mechanism.
results.trapi_notes: All graph paths are TRAPI-expressible; target-driver identity, disease rank, activity degree, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:ENABLES]->(activity:MolecularActivity)
      <-[:ENABLES]-(driver:Gene)
MATCH (target)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]-(driver)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
MATCH (driver)-[evidence:MINER_GENE_DISEASE_EVIDENCE]->(object)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier = 'loss_of_function_variant_form'
  AND evidence._miner_disease_rank <= 3
  AND activity._miner_gene_enable_degree <= 58
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
